answer: Give every agent identity a slow-growing trust beacon that only brightens after weeks of continuous, useful work. A fresh identity starts dark and must wander through a probationary period doing small, verifiable jobs before it can touch anything valuable — like timber seasoning, trust cannot be rushed or bought in bulk. A sybil operator would need to tend hundreds of identities for months to match one seasoned agent, so the time cost of forging an army exceeds any profit from faking it.
